summary: Diff implements non-(reps/time) monthly totals as checked-day counts and updates HabitRow UI to show Monthly total and Goal together for those habits. It also replaces inline row editing with a popover containing a single edit action that opens a new HabitEditModal for editing name/unit/volume. One potential gap is that the modal’s cancel/close behavior cannot be verified due to truncation.

missing_requirements.requirement: Cancel/close leaves the habit unchanged and closes the modal.
missing_requirements.reason: HabitEditModal.tsx is truncated before showing the cancel/close handlers and footer buttons, so it’s not possible to confirm that cancel/close does not persist changes and that it closes the modal.

hallucinated_features.description: Preset unit list includes "km" and a custom-unit toggle mechanism in the edit modal.
hallucinated_features.reason: The request only required editing existing fields (name, unit type, selected month’s volume/goal) and did not ask for adding preset units or custom-unit UI behavior.
